repos.description: The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
repos.summary_zh: LiteLLM 是一个统一的大语言模型网关和 Python SDK，可将 100+ 种 LLM API 转换为 OpenAI 格式调用。提供代理服务器模式，集成成本追踪、负载均衡、安全护栏和日志监控等企业级功能。支持 Bedrock、Azure、Anthropic 等主流平台，简化多模型管理和切换，适用于需要统一 AI 接口、成本控制和生产级部署的场景。
repos.summary_en: LiteLLM is a unified LLM gateway and Python SDK that standardizes 100+ model APIs into OpenAI format. It offers proxy server mode with enterprise features including cost tracking, load balancing, guardrails, and logging. Supporting major platforms like Bedrock, Azure, and Anthropic, it simplifies multi-model management and switching for production deployments requiring unified AI interfaces and cost control.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一款下一代 LLM 网关与 AI 资产管理系统，通过协议转换层将各类大模型统一为 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 兼容接口。提供集中式模型路由、分发与管理能力，支持个人与企业级部署，构建跨模型生态的标准化接入平面。
repos.summary_en: New API is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management system that unifies diverse large language models through protocol conversion layers into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini-compatible interfaces. It provides centralized model routing, load balancing, and distribution management for both personal and enterprise deployments. Built with Go for high performance, the system acts as a standardized access plane for cross-model ecosystems, enabling seamless integration, governance, and observability of heterogeneous AI assets while maintaining strict API compatibility and enterprise-grade security.

repos.description: The all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding. InsForge gives your coding agent database, auth, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway to ship full-stack apps end-to-end.
repos.summary_zh: InsForge 是专为 AI 编程代理打造的**开源一体化后端平台**，提供数据库、认证、存储、计算、托管及 AI 网关等全栈能力。通过 **MCP Server** 和 **CLI+Skills** 双模式，让 AI 代理能像资深后端工程师一样操作资源，实现应用开发、部署、调试的端到端自动化，极大提升 AI 编程效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: InsForge is an **open-source, all-in-one backend platform** purpose-built for agentic coding. It equips AI coding agents with comprehensive capabilities including database, authentication, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway. Through dual interfaces of **MCP Server** (self-hosted/cloud) and **CLI+Skills** (cloud-only), agents can operate backend resources like professional engineers, enabling **end-to-end automation** of full-stack application development, deployment, and debugging, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and quality.

repos.summary_zh: Manifest 是开源 LLM 网关，专为 AI Agent 与应用设计。通过统一 OpenAI 兼容端点，智能路由 API Key、订阅与本地模型请求至最优模型，支持 300+ 模型与 35+ 提供商。核心能力包括自动降级与故障自愈、全量请求日志、实时成本追踪与限额告警，消除单一供应商锁定，显著提升 Agent 可靠性并降低调用成本。
repos.summary_en: Manifest is an open-source LLM gateway for AI agents and apps. It unifies API keys, subscriptions, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, intelligently routing requests to the optimal model across 300+ models and 35+ providers. Key features include automatic fallbacks with self-healing, full request logging, real-time cost tracking, and usage limits—eliminating vendor lock-in while boosting agent reliability and cutting costs.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供免费HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4及SOCKS5代理列表，每5分钟自动抓取验证更新，覆盖105国家约3900个有效代理，支持TXT/JSON/CSV多格式，按协议分类且无重复。核心价值是实时可靠的代理资源池，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集、隐私保护及绕过地理限制等场景。技术亮点包括自动化验证、多协议支持、便捷下载及NPM模块集成。
repos.summary_en: The proxifly/free-proxy-list repository provides a free, frequently updated list of HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies, fetched and validated every 5 minutes from 105 countries with around 3900 working entries. Available in TXT, JSON, and CSV formats, categorized by protocol and country with no duplicates. Core value lies in delivering real-time, reliable proxy resources ideal for web scraping, data collection, anonymity, and bypassing restrictions. Technical highlights include automated validation, multi-protocol support, easy downloads, and NPM module integration.

repos.description: ChatGPT 官网接口纯协议逆向实现，Go 语言编写，高并发、低内存、高性能。指纹级请求还原，支持 GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图、GIF 动图、文本模型与语音合成/转写，兼容 OpenAI 接口协议，在线批量生图，号池管理，支持导入 CPA、sub2api 号池，可接入 Cherry Studio、New API 等软件
repos.summary_zh: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw AI Gateway on Android — standalone Flutter app with built-in terminal, web dashboard, and one-tap setup. Also available as a Termux CLI package.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 将 OpenClaw AI 网关移植到 Android 平台，提供免 root 的 Flutter 独立应用和 Termux CLI 两种模式。通过 proot 技术自动构建 Ubuntu 环境并安装 Node.js 22 和 OpenClaw，实现一键部署。应用内置终端模拟器、Web 管理面板、实时日志查看和网关启停控制，支持 API 密钥配置和后台常驻服务。可选安装 Go 和 Homebrew 开发工具，让 Android 设备成为便携的 AI 网关节点。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw brings the OpenClaw AI Gateway to Android via a standalone Flutter app and Termux CLI package. It uses proot to automatically set up an Ubuntu environment with Node.js 22 and OpenClaw, requiring no root access. The app features a built-in terminal emulator, embedded web dashboard, real-time log viewer, and gateway controls. It supports one-tap deployment, API key configuration, background foreground service, and optional installation of Go and Homebrew tools, turning Android devices into portable AI gateway nodes.

repos.description: Realm 全功能一键中转脚本，终端可视化界面构建网络转发服务.Realm: Full-featured one-click network relay — configure and manage forwarding rules from an interactive TUI.
repos.summary_zh: 纯Shell脚本实现的Realm全功能网络中转管理工具，提供交互式TUI界面一键配置转发规则。同步官方最新特性（TCP/UDP、WS/WSS/TLS隧道、MPTCP、多入口多出口、Proxy Protocol），并扩展负载均衡、故障转移、端口流量监控限速与网络链路测试，支持多发行版与离线安装，极简高效搭建中转服务器。
repos.summary_en: A pure Shell-script tool for full-featured Realm network relay management with an interactive TUI. Syncs all official Realm capabilities (TCP/UDP, WS/WSS/TLS tunnels, MPTCP, multi-entry/exit, Proxy Protocol) and adds load balancing, failover, port traffic monitoring/limiting, and link testing. Supports multiple distros and offline install for lightweight relay server setup.

repos.description: 用Go语言写的腾讯 CodeBuddy 账号池Cli/Web管理控制台 + OpenAI 兼容反代网关
repos.summary_zh: 纯Go实现的腾讯CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy本地AI代理网关，零CGO、跨平台单二进制。纯CLI管理账号池，支持国内国际双站混挂、轮询负载均衡、模型级冷却隔离、免费优先调度、自动签到与Token续期，提供完整OpenAI兼容接口（Chat Completions/Responses），适合本地或服务器部署AI客户端反代。
repos.summary_en: Pure Go local AI proxy gateway for Tencent CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy. Zero-CGO single binary, CLI-only account pool management supporting CN/intl dual sites, round-robin load balancing, model-level isolation, free-tier priority, auto check-in and token refresh. Full OpenAI-compatible endpoints for seamless client integration.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible Web Chat API proxy with GPT, Grok, Gemini account management and Docker self-hosting
repos.summary_zh: webchat2api 将 ChatGPT Web、Grok/xAI Web 与 Gemini Web 逆向封装为 OpenAI 兼容及 Gemini 原生 API 代理，支持多账号池管理、文生文/文生图、tier 感知调度与 Docker 一键自托管。提供 FastAPI 后端与 Next.js 管理后台，覆盖账号导入、代理配置、内容过滤、云备份及图片存储，适合个人学习与私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: webchat2api wraps ChatGPT Web, Grok/xAI Web and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible and Gemini native API proxies, with multi-account pools, text/image generation, tier-aware routing and Docker self-hosting. Features FastAPI backend plus Next.js admin UI for account management, proxies, content filtering, cloud backup and image storage—ideal for personal research and private deployments.
